Google Quantum AI has launched a Kaggle competition offering $150 000 in prizes to teams that can compress fault‑tolerant quantum circuits with AI agents. The contest aims to reduce the overhead of logical qubits and improve the scalability of quantum hardware. Participants will develop algorithms that shorten circuit depth while maintaining error‑correcting properties, advancing practical quantum computing.
